description: Lab values (3b contract, decision 3 and its 2026-11-03 rules). Units with conversion factors to a canonical unit, the checked adult reference interval (ABIM January 2026), and the plausible range derived in code (aitx/evidence/labs.py): reference low / 10 to reference high x 10, in the canonical unit. A stated unit whose value is implausible is reread only as a unit of the same dimension whose factor differs by >= 100x (unit slips such as mg vs g); otherwise unknown. A unit whose factor is not verified (factor null) can never be assumed and is never ruled out for a value without a unit. An analyte is used only when status is 'verified'.

mmol/L.source: PENDING: no citable authoritative source checked. The AMA Manual of Style SI converter (11th ed., academic.oup.com/amamanualofstyle/si-conversion-calculator, read 2026-11-03) lists hemoglobin only as g/dL x 10 = g/L. Secondary tables give 0.6206 (globin monomer, ~16 kDa) or 0.155 (tetramer, ~64.5 kDa). Until checked, mmol/L cannot be assumed and cannot be ruled out.
